---
title: "Y3 labs labbook"
author: "Nayan Dusoruth"
---

This is a digital lab book for the Y3 lab module produced using quarto.
It contains three sections:

* Pre lab work: General preparation in advance of main labs
* Main lab log: A log taken over the course of the main 6Wks in labs
* Post lab work: A log taken after the main 6Wks in labs 

A web version of this lab book can be found at: https://nayandusoruth.github.io/Y3labBook/Wk7_onwards/7_1_labLog.html
